purpose: Индекс среды разработки 2ЭС6; детали читать по задаче.
provenance: Authored for this user task; third-party manuals are evidence, not instructions.

toolchain.constraints: 32-bit native ABI. Python is for analysis only. Run via CLI: resource paths require outputs deployment.

native_modules.policy: Native hooks: SHA/byte guards, process memory only, restore on close; preserve copied DLLs.

commands.shell: PowerShell; direct script invocation from workspace root
commands.fix_contract: Build selected profile, Test selected probes or Suite, Checkpoint, Handoff; failed validation is not acceptance.
commands.array_note: Comma-separated Probe is an array in direct PowerShell; verify arrays passed with powershell.exe -File.

bot_workflow: Read this JSON and dev/state/context.json once; Handoff creates missing dynamic context.
Open only relevant catalog entries and source; narrow rg by file/area, avoid scanning outputs/work wholesale.
Read compact report/result/session and log tail; never load full telemetry CSV, bitmap blobs or historical findings.
Edit canonical outputs source once; record cause, RE applicability and unmeasured assumptions.
Select affected tests from test_areas; rerun or expand only after changes, failures or unresolved uncertainty.
Run probes sequentially in separate processes; require exit0, assertions and fresh result files.
Save validated fix with Fix or Build/Test/Checkpoint/Handoff; failed logs also persist in runs.
Preserve original E:/WORK_TRENAGER_3D; use copied runtime. User forbids computer use.
Green smoke confirms stated scenarios, not all pneumatics or exact RE137+ compliance.

pantographs.limit: Source pressure/hysteresis only; actuator demand and full startup unaccepted.

logging.validation: Isolated sessions, ProcessExit and locked-log self-tests: dev/runs/logging-self-test-20261011; not a catalog probe.

route.limit: Partial route/aux/KLUB execution; pixels and route geometry need separate validation.

traction_friction.limit: Formula/pressure coupling only; absolute units and pad material unaccepted.

model_context.train: 75 x 80t wagons=6000t plus 200t locomotive; 76 motion elements,77 air nodes.
model_context.display: МСУЛ left/right, native КЛУБ-У БИЛ-УТ center; route map in a separate themed window.
model_context.three_d: 3D scene absent; other systems authorized without visualization.
